sloka: विचरिष्यन्ति भद्रम् ते देवरूपाः तव आत्मजाः ।एवम् तौ निश्चयम् कृत्वा माता पुत्रौ तपोवने ॥१-४७-९॥
transliteration: vicariṣyanti bhadram te devarūpāḥ tava ātmajāḥ ।evam tau niścayam kṛtvā mātā putrau tapovane ॥1-47-9॥

translations.english: "O Rama mother and sons having arrived at this conclusion in the tapovana ascended to heaven with their desire fulfilled. This is what we have heard."
